$comment: Single source of truth for which taw-theme paths are framework-owned and safe to sync into a client project. Read by both the update-theme Claude Code skill and TAW\CLI\SyncCommand (php bin/taw sync) — keep them pointed at this file rather than hardcoding the lists twice. Tier 1 is always overwritten without confirmation; Tier 2 is diffed and requires human review before being applied; anything not listed is never read or touched.
$never: tests/Unit/ is deliberately never listed here, in either tier, and must never become a 'dir' entry — it holds each client project's own block tests (tests/Unit/Blocks/{Name}Test.php), content this manifest doesn't own. A 'dir' entry syncs via 'rsync -a --delete', which would silently delete every client-authored test not present in the canonical repo. Only the harness itself (tests/bootstrap.php, tests/TestCase.php, phpunit.xml) is framework-owned; individual test files are not.
